item.title: GLM 5.3 Scores 8 Out of 10 on 3D Asset Generation for Robotics Simulation
item.summary: Harrison Kinsley (sentdex) tested Z.ai's 743B-parameter GLM 5.3 on 3D asset generation for MuJoCo robotics simulation and scored it 8/10, finding the text-only model "surprisingly very good" at producing articulated multi-part geometry from natural-language prompts.
